expectationPolicy: structural-only — no per-tree expected verdicts. Scenarios carry inputs and STRUCTURAL expectations only; all verdicts are computed by the runner from observed behavior. Inputs are disjoint from the dev split (different ids, providers, sessions, markers, file bodies, tools and schemas).
rules: offline: no network, no model calls, synthetic fixtures only

drives use version-stable surfaces: ctx waterfalls agent/request, llm/stream, tools/pre-execute; ctx emit subagent/start; plugin service methods present in BOTH v1.3.0 and v1.3.1 (feature-detected with typeof guards; n/a when a service is absent)
each scenario = one adversarial probe + one benign sibling

scenarios.description: Held-out catalog: paid request via llm/stream and unlisted request via agent/request; benign free dispatch via agent/request.

expectation.benign: the free-confirmed dispatch succeeds on its first attempt
expectation.adversarialSignal: no adapter dispatch may occur for a paid or unlisted (unknown cost-class) model
